key_build_script_review.observation: build.rs:4-13 hashes local schema, writes identity into OUT_DIR and invokes capnpc CompilerCommand (local capnp executable)
builder/main.rs:440 and 1356 dispatch build tooling/cc; CMake or other bundled native-build branches exist; not a source-only Rust graph
build.rs:539,622,639 performs C/assembly compilation and process invocation
build.rs:55-61,241,265-279 chooses pkg-config or bundled C compilation; selected features omit bindgen
build.rs:24 invokes rustc for version probing

bypass_boundaries: Reqwest/default-tls/system-proxy and Tokio fs/net/process features are resolved through upstream dependencies; the harness explicitly injects a refusing transport, but these capabilities remain in the broader dependency code.
codex-websocket-client, codex-http-client and codex-network-proxy are in the closure. Passing this endpoint test does not prove all core transport construction paths are redirected.
Cargo --offline and directory source replacement prevent Cargo downloads; they are not OS-level network or build-script process isolation.
No automatic download path was identified in the reviewed key entrypoint snippets; this is not a comprehensive audit of every transitive build tool or script.
The isolated lock records path identities for the two forks; exact commits are carried by the separately hash-bound source and manifest-patch receipts rather than Git URLs inside Cargo.lock.
